name: Hanasaki Mei
source:
Hobbies: Playing games (especially otomege and BL games)
Likes: [url=/c98082]Kiriha[/url], otome games
Dislikes: The word "marriage", her height (has a complex about it)

Kiriha's manager who works at the Rain Tears agency. She has an innocent and pure nature, and as such gets often deceived or tricked by people.
She often says she wants a boyfriend, but she has a hard time getting one because she keeps comparing them to otome game characters... to the point where even Kiriha thinks that her expectations are too high.

[Based on the [url=http://ainolinks.com/]official website[/url]]
